newsitem.title: USA: Hydron Technologies renegotiates with QVC.
newsitem.headline: Hydron Technologies renegotiates with QVC.

text.p: Hydron Technologies Inc said on Friday that it had renegotiated its license agreement with television shopping channel QVC Inc, extending the agreement's term for one year.

The amendment also allows QVC to maintain its exclusive rights to Hydron if QVC buys $12.5 million of Hydron brand consumer products during the annual period ending May 31, 1998, and $30 million for the the two-year period ending May 31, 1999, Hydron said in a statement.

"No assurances can be given that QVC will meet such escalating minimum purchase levels in order to maintain its exclusive rights," the personal care products company said. QVC Inc is principally owned by Comcast Corp.
